purpose: T11 B3/R3 event-probability baselines on the owner-frozen R1 cohort; no action utility, trading, or profitability claim

upstream_r1.scope_note: R1 receipt proves timestamp/label isolation and nonempty PIT phases only; it is not a baseline result or training authorization.

cohort.model_input: The T11 runner projects only the 11 feature values in the declared order. asset_id, venue, decision_ns, record ID, label, fold, group and regime metadata never enter a predictor. financial_pit_v1.model_input is an audit projection and must not be passed to an estimator.

fold_policy.selection: dev metrics on primary instruments only; test is never used for model, seed, or threshold selection
fold_policy.calibration: calibration metrics on primary instruments only; no fitted calibration transform is part of T11 v1
fold_policy.fit_rows: Retained train rows from the unmodified R1 validator, restricted to primary instruments. No calendar stress exclusion is applied in T11.
fold_policy.empty_phase_rule: Any empty phase after instrument restriction is a hard preflight failure; no fold may be skipped.

instrument_holdout.hash_sort: SHA-256 of the full key, ascending lexicographic digest then key
instrument_holdout.fit_rule: Only primary enters fitting, development, and calibration. Holdout groups are untouched until test readout.
instrument_holdout.venue_holdout: unsatisfiable in Binance-only V1; report as limitation, never silently imply venue generalization.

calendar_stress_windows.role_in_t11: pre-registered descriptive test strata only; no row is removed from train/dev/calibration and no metric from a stress stratum may drive selection
calendar_stress_windows.reason: The first R1 dev window overlaps the 2025 stress window. Treating it as a fitting holdout would make dev empty; changing or deleting the window after seeing this would be an in-place protocol repair.
calendar_stress_windows.regime_masks: Deferred to T12 B5 real-data validation. T11 does not claim point-in-time regime labels or regime-holdout generalization.

linear.initialization: all weights and bias exactly zero
linear.standardization: train-only mean and positive scale, then reuse unchanged for dev/calibration/test
linear.budget_rule: same objective-independent step count, batch rule and seed permutation for CE/Brier pairs; report every seed

boosted_stumps.name: gradient_boosted_stumps
boosted_stumps.threshold_rule: deterministic train-only adjacent-value partitions; no test-derived thresholds

metrics.calibration_reporting: raw probability metrics; fitted calibration is deferred and cannot use test
metrics.interval: paired candidate-minus-baseline 95% percentile bootstrap over whole instrument groups, shared resampled indices, seed 1729, 1000 replicates; no row-iid bootstrap

authorization.approval_note: This is a T11 protocol/preflight artifact. It does not override project review gates or authorize fitting. A separate review receipt must flip fit authorization.

change_rule: Any change to upstream hashes, instrument group, stress role, fold use, candidate budget, seed list, metric definition or interval unit creates a new protocol version; no in-place repair.
